major_issues.problem: The phrase is mainly a request for favorable treatment; reciprocity is usually こちらこそよろしく, a reply.
major_issues.suggestion: Optional line edit later: request, not automatic two-way offering.

final_summary: PASS with no revision round (major=1). The article already treats yoroshiku as a relational closer, not untranslatable magic, and splits shop please from first-meeting/email use. Remaining major: lede ‘offers it back’ over-symmetrizes a request.
title: Why Japanese People Say Yoroshiku Onegaishimasu
